easy_fields.description: VoiceAssistant-Eval is a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess AI assistants across listening, speaking, and viewing. It comprises 10,497 curated examples spanning 13 task categories, including natural sounds, music, spoken dialogue, multi-turn dialogue, role-play imitation, and heterogeneous images. The benchmark establishes a rigorous framework for evaluating and guiding the development of next-generation AI assistants.
